photoProblem.title: We couldn’t see the leaf clearly
photoProblem.body: The photo is too blurry to check. Nothing is lost — take one more.
tips: Hold the phone a hand-width from one leaf.
Stand with the sun behind you, not in front.
Keep still for 2 seconds while the photo is taken.

data.headline: Inama is not sure what this is
data.whatsHappening: The photo is too blurry to check. Nothing is lost — take one more.
data.whyItMatters: Different problems need different care. A wrong spray costs money and doesn’t help.
steps: Take a sharp photo of one sick leaf, close up, in daylight.
Send it to your farmer promoter or an agronomist to check.

escalation.reason: Inama is not sure — a person should check.
